data.name: 千年玄剑
data.detailed_description:
QianNian XuanJian is a retro 2D martial-arts MMORPG built around character progression, combat growth, and online player interaction. Early quests help players learn the maps, NPCs, combat flow, and core systems, while the later game gradually opens into monster hunting, equipment progression, martial-arts training, dungeons, events, and multiplayer Jianghu-style activity.

Players start from a classic martial world, improve their characters through long-term training and combat, collect equipment and resources, learn different weapon paths, and take part in team play, guild cooperation, battlefield conflict, and PvP encounters.

Key features:
- Retro 2D martial-arts MMORPG experience
- Guided early quests for easier onboarding
- Monster hunting, equipment drops, upgrades, and long-term progression
- Multiple weapon paths and martial-arts growth
- Dungeons, event maps, battlefields, and online interaction
- Classic Jianghu setting, village exploration, and outdoor adventure

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible graphics device
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Online connection required.

Recommended:

  • Processor: Quad-core processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
